title: Saga Order Fulfillment Architecture
description: An order fulfillment saga architecture diagram with four sequential steps: customer verification, inventory reservation, payment authorization, and shipment creation, with a compensation chain that reverses completed steps on failure. This template models the end-to-end order lifecycle as a saga, showing how each service participates in the transaction and how compensating actions maintain data consistency. Ideal for e-commerce architects designing reliable order processing pipelines.
